messages:
ivy: Heads-up: after the static assets CDN cutover, our in-page anchor links (e.g., #quickstart) are intermittently jumping to top of page or 404ing on mobile. Seen on /sdk/python and /guides/auth.
sitebot: [linkcheck] 6a7 Anchor mismatch: /sdk/python/#quickstart -> /sdk/python/index.html#line-1 (404 on mobile UA)
omar: Can you repro locally with the site build? What does the generated HTML contain for the anchor target?
ivy: In the generated output the heading id is `id="quickstart_1"` but our markdown plugin should produce `quickstart`. It looks like the anchor normalizer appended suffixes when duplicate slugs were detected after we flattened headers during a mdx-to-html pass.
priyanka: That sounds like the slug dedupe step ran twice. We also rewrote image paths to /assets which changed header context (frontmatter include) so the slug collision list changed.
sitebot: [build] 527 Build job 7890: mdx-plugin-slugify v1.3.0 applied. Duplicate slugs resolved by appending _1, _2, ...
omar: Quick fix: run a slug canonicalization step that uses the original source header text rather than file path context. I can open a PR to patch the mdx slug plugin config.
ivy: Also seeing some absolute -> relative conversions in code samples where we render SDK snippet replacing `https://api.redwood.ai` with `{{ base_url }}`. Those templates now generate broken links when base_url is CDN. Might be unrelated but messy.
priyanka: Let's do two things: 1) hotfix the generated HTML to map suffixed ids back to expected anchors for the short term, 2) patch the slugifier to use the original heading text so the IDs are deterministic.
devops-bot: [deploy] 4a8 Patch branch docs/slug-fix created. CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/teams/docs/7901
omar: Hotfix script I ran in CI (temporary):
```bash
# map id="quickstart_1" -> id="quickstart" if quickstart doesn't exist
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for p in Path('site').rglob('*.html'):
    s = p.read_text()
    s = s.replace('id="quickstart_1"', 'id="quickstart"')
    p.write_text(s)
print('patched')
PY
```
priyanka: Good stopgap. Please add a tiny linkcheck test that visits anchors with a mobile UA so we catch UA-specific redirect oddities.
ivy: I pushed a small test to the PR and ran it on staging; anchors now resolve. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/712
omar: Reviewing now. Two minor nits about comment clarity, otherwise LGTM. After merge I'll schedule a follow-up to roll the slugifier change into next week's release.
sitebot: [deploy] 44c Staging deploy succeeded (job 7909). Linkcheck: anchors OK.
iv y: thanks team, leaving DOCS-331 to track the long-term slugifier change and DOCS-332 for SDK snippet base_url templating cleanup. Closing this thread. :lock:
